subject: Urgent: P1 handoff authorization and temporary on-call coverage for ZenLedger
messages:
From: Sara Cohen <sara@zenledger.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: SupportOps <supportops@zenledger.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Repeated P1 latency hits overnight — request for temporary on-call guarantee

Hi Rishi,

We're seeing repeated P1 latency failures to our inference endpoints between 02:00–04:30 PT over the last three nights. This is impacting batch reconciliation jobs and a small amount of customer-facing reports. Our stack traces show timeouts while waiting for token-stream responses; ops have files attached (short logs) and are asking whether Redwood can temporarily guarantee an accelerated on-call escalation for P1s during our nightly window (our cutover is 23:30 PT).

We understand this is an exception to the current contract, but given the revenue impact and tight timeline of our quarter close, we need either: (a) a committed 30-minute P1 acknowledge/2-hour resolution handoff during 23:30–05:00 PT for the next two weeks, or (b) a prioritized playbook that keeps us under the current SLA but provides an immediately available escalation path with a named engineer.

Attachments: zenledger-ops-snippet.txt (log excerpt), zenledger-sla-summary.xlsx

Can you let us know if Redwood can authorize this temporary coverage or what the fastest path to approval is?

Thanks,
Sara Cohen
Director, Platform Engineering
ZenLedger

---
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Repeated P1 latency hits overnight — request for temporary on-call guarantee

Team — forwarding urgent ask from ZenLedger. Summary: consecutive overnight P1 latency windows hitting their batch/reports. They want a temporary tightening of P1 response/ack times for their nightly window for two weeks (ZL-2026-117).

High level ask: authorize a temporary SLA carve-in: 30m ack / 2h remediation for P1 during 23:30–05:00 PT for 14 days, and a named escalation engineer on-call (they specifically want a single point of contact). They are open to an invoice for the override.

Operational notes: Attached is their ops snippet; they report timeouts waiting on token streaming. Could be a routing/regional overload or a model-specific KV cache regression. Ben — can you triage immediate mitigation steps (prefetching/pinning recommendations) and confirm whether an engineer can be assigned as the named contact? Marissa/Laura — what approvals do we need to signal an SLA exception and what are the short legal/contract checkpoints?

I think we can approve operationally if Marissa signs off and legal does a short addendum; I want this to be quick. Please advise with next steps by EOD today — ZenLedger is moving fast on quarter close.

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

+Context and tentative approval:

Thanks for the loop, Rishi. Ben and I reviewed the logs and the pattern suggests regional capacity pressure possibly combined with a KV cache miss pattern on the model variant they're using. Operationally we can:
- Assign a named engineer (on-call partner: D. Nguyen, Backend Reliability) to be the single escalation point for ZenLedger.
- Implement a temporary routing policy to pin ZenLedger traffic to a lower-latency pool during 23:30–05:00 PT.
- Enable an aggressive prefix caching window for their routes.

Conditions for approval:
1) This is a 14-calendar-day temporary amendment, after which we'll revert to standard SLOs unless a renewal is approved.
2) ZenLedger signs a one-page addendum accepting a temporary premium for the dedicated coverage (we'll bill at the overnight on-call premium rate).
3) Legal needs to confirm contract language; Laura, please confirm if a short addendum with signatures is sufficient or if we need PO/DocuSign.

Ben — please confirm ETA for the routing pin and caching changes (I need a timestamp). I'll approve the operational changes once you confirm it's safe to apply without impacting other customers' latency. Rishi — once Legal confirms, we'll send a formal note to ZenLedger and include D. Nguyen in the named contact.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Support
Redwood Inference

- Ben will follow up with an ops timeline and a short post-change checklist.
